PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Production & Engineering

Job Responsibilities

• Oversee and ensure smooth execution of daily production activities to achieve production targets, quality standards, and operational efficiency.
• Manage and improve maintenance systems to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime.
• Monitor and analyze manufacturing performance using OEE, productivity, quality, and other operational metrics.
• Implement continuous improvement programs such as Lean Manufacturing, TPM, and Six Sigma initiatives.
• Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and develop corrective and preventive actions for operational issues.
• Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure effective communication and collaboration in achieving business objectives.
• Ensure compliance with company regulations, safety standards, and operational procedures.
• Prepare and present production and engineering reports to management for data-driven decision making.

Job Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Industrial Engineering.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in manufacturing (Production or Engineering functions); outstanding fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
• Strong understanding of production processes, maintenance systems, and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, TPM, Six Sigma).
• Ability to analyze manufacturing performance using OEE, productivity, and quality indicators.
• Excellent problem-solving capability, including Root Cause Analysis and data-based decision making.
• Strong leadership, communication, and teamwork skills.
• Highly disciplined, responsible, and results-oriented.

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Sidoarjo
Production & Engineering

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

• Mengawasi dan memastikan kelancaran kegiatan produksi harian untuk mencapai target produksi, standar kualitas, dan efisiensi operasional.
• Mengelola serta meningkatkan sistem pemeliharaan (maintenance) guna memaksimalkan keandalan peralatan dan meminimalkan downtime.
• Memantau dan menganalisis kinerja manufaktur menggunakan indikator OEE, produktivitas, kualitas, dan metrik operasional lainnya.
• Mengimplementasikan program perbaikan berkelanjutan seperti Lean Manufacturing, TPM, dan Six Sigma.
• Melakukan Root Cause Analysis (RCA) serta menyusun tindakan perbaikan dan pencegahan terhadap permasalahan operasional.
• Berkoordinasi dengan berbagai fungsi untuk memastikan komunikasi dan kerja sama yang efektif dalam mencapai target perusahaan.
• Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap peraturan perusahaan, standar keselamatan kerja, dan prosedur operasional yang berlaku.
• Menyusun dan menyampaikan laporan produksi serta engineering sebagai dasar pengambilan keputusan berbasis data.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

• Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, atau Teknik Industri.
• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang manufaktur (Produksi atau Engineering); fresh graduate berprestasi dipersilakan melamar.
• Memahami proses produksi, sistem maintenance, dan metodologi continuous improvement (Lean, TPM, Six Sigma).
• Mampu menganalisis kinerja manufaktur menggunakan indikator OEE, produktivitas, dan kualitas.
• Memiliki kemampuan problem solving yang baik, termasuk Root Cause Analysis dan pengambilan keputusan berbasis data.
• Memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan, kemampuan komunikasi, dan kerja sama tim yang kuat.
• Disiplin tinggi, bertanggung jawab, dan berorientasi pada hasil.
• Bersedia ditempatkan di Sidoarjo, Jawa Timur.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

wo-klbf-JR26_001802.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

• Ensure the effectiveness and compliance rate of quality and food safety standards (FSSC 22000, Halal, Kosher, and CPPOB).
• Maintain and manage up-to-date documentation across hardcopy files and the electronic Quality Management System (Document Controller).
• Drive and optimize production line readiness and availability for Kosher manufacturing.
• Champion and evaluate the implementation of the internal Food Safety Culture.
• Handle statutory, environmental, and industrial compliance (UKL/UPL, industrial business licensing, domestic investment permits, and local domicile permits).

Company:
GVN PT. Global Vita Nutritech
